name: Zephyr Presrv™ 6.0 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel Outdoor Kegerator
shortDescription: Your outdoor entertaining just got upgraded with a kegerator and beverage cooler that is versatile enough for even the most creative of hosts. This corrosion-resistant, stainless steel, hybrid kegerator can accommodate multiple keg configurations and easily functions as a beverage cooler when a keg is not installed. Purchase one of the single, double, or triple tap kits to complete your dream configuration. Optional accessories include casters and a drink guardrail for use in freestanding installations. Also certified for indoor use.
